review.tagline: Python agent framework with a multi-tenant FastAPI agent service
review.summary: AgentScope 2.0 is a Python 3.11+ SDK for composing ReAct agents from a toolkit (Python tools, MCP servers, skills, shell and file tools), model adapters, context compaction, middleware and permission checks. It also ships an agent service: a FastAPI backend with a sample web UI, multi-tenant sessions, agent teams, Feishu and Discord channels, RAG, scheduling and SQL/NoSQL persistence.
review.audience: Python developers building agent apps and multi-user agent backends
strengths: Wide model support: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DashScope, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Volcengine, xAI, Ollama, MiniMax
Sandbox backends include Docker, Bubblewrap, E2B, Daytona, K8s and Apple Container
Built-in permission system with human confirmation and composable middleware
Agent service adds multi-tenancy, scheduling, agent teams and A2A support beyond the SDK
weaknesses: Realtime voice and SOP features are marked Experimental
Web UI needs a separate pnpm/Node setup from the Python backend
README gives no hardware requirements and no Docker or compose files
2.0 is a new major version; README does not cover migration from 1.x
needs: Needs Python 3.11+, pnpm (web UI), LLM provider API key
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DashScope, DeepSeek
